pr_title: Fix for CSG nodes not being able to be exported as glTF
pr_body:
This is an attempt to fix #57667

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/18116695/153585284-71e479a7-c3e1-4e4a-8856-ec696ab2e4b3.png)

It works but unlike `GLTFDocument::_convert_mesh_to_gltf` when a material isn't applied, I've assigned a default `StandardMaterial3D` because of #57955

*Bugsquad edit:*
- Fixes #57667
pr_comments:
I tested using https://github.khronos.org/glTF-Validator/ and with a test project.
[3d csg export Game Project.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/8048914/3d.csg.export.Game.Project.zip)

Seems to work.

issue_context.title: CSG export to gltf failed
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

4.0 alpha 1

### System information

popos 21.04 Linux, Vulkan, NVIDIA 3000 series

### Issue description

Exporting CSG as gltf fails.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a first csg box
2. Create a second csg box
3. Change the second box to be intersect
4. Export as gltf
5. gltf can not be read in godot or using a gltf validator or blender 3

### Minimal reproduction project

[CSG Export Game Project.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/8008427/CSG.Export.Game.Project.zip)

review_comments: I think `mat = memnew(StandardMaterial3D);` will work too.
I'm getting an error saying that operator is ambiguous with `mat = memnew(StandardMaterial3D)`, so I think it's better to keep it unchanged.
